title: Psammis
summary: King of Egypt, son of Necho (Herodotus 2.159–161).
description: Added from the Herodotus import (The Histories, tr. Rawlinson). Herodotus gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not BC years, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Herodotus is display-only and gives none).

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Start: 594; End: 589). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.note: Row "Khaemwaset / Psamtik II" of Table 2 (Egypt Dynasties 19 and 26). CFAH-9 identifies Khaemwaset of Dynasty 19 with Psamtik II (Herodotus' Psammis).
